form.label: Oracle E-Business Suite Security and Audit Overview
form.description: Operator dashboard for the conservative Oracle E-Business Suite normalized JSON relay. Panels are grounded in synthetic-equivalent fixtures and public May/June 2026 Oracle advisory context; they are not proof of native EBS validation or exploit detection.

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype="oracle:ebs:security:json" source_mode="ebs_security_json_relay" | spath | eval user=coalesce(user, ebs_user), component=coalesce(application, module, component), status=coalesce(status, tostring(request_status), tostring(http_status)), risk_bucket=case(severity="critical","critical", severity="high","high", status="failure" OR status="error" OR status="blocked","attention", isnotnull(cve),"advisory_focus", true(),"informational") | search user="$user_filter$" component="$component_filter$"

html.p: Source-mode caveat: this view is scoped only to source_mode=ebs_security_json_relay. Native EBS table, AuditTrail shadow table, OHS, WebLogic, Forms/OAF, and Workflow log grammars remain blocked until source-backed samples and Splunk read-back are retained. Synthetic-equivalent fixtures are for onboarding and SPL quality only.

search.query: | search severity IN ("critical","high") OR risk_bucket IN ("critical","high") | stats count
| search event_family="ebs_signon_failure" OR action="authentication" status="failure" | stats count
| search advisory_month="May 2026" OR cve="CVE-2026-46817" OR event_family="ebs_enterprise_command_center" | stats count
| timechart span=1h count by event_family limit=12 useother=f
| stats count by risk_bucket status | sort - count

table.title: Onboarding coverage by index, source, host, and family

search.query: | stats count dc(sechub_fixture_marker) as marker_count values(index) as indexes values(source) as sources values(host) as hosts values(event_type) as event_types by sourcetype event_family source_mode | sort event_family

| search event_family="ebs_signon_failure" OR action="authentication" OR status="failure" | table _time event_family user ebs_user responsibility application src_ip client_host action status failure_reason server_name message sechub_fixture_marker | sort - _time

| search event_family="ebs_audittrail_sensitive_change" OR application="System Administration" OR responsibility="System Administrator" | table _time user responsibility application table_name object_name column_name old_value new_value config_scope action status severity message sechub_fixture_marker | sort - _time

| search event_family="ebs_audittrail_sensitive_change" | table _time user responsibility application table_name object_name column_name primary_key old_value new_value action status severity message sechub_fixture_marker | sort - _time

table.title: Concurrent request failures and privileged submissions

search.query: | search event_family="ebs_concurrent_privileged_request" | table _time user responsibility application request_id program phase request_status action status severity message sechub_fixture_marker | sort - _time

table.title: Workflow, notification mailer, and routing errors

search.query: | search event_family="ebs_workflow_mailer_change" | table _time user application notification_id workflow_item_type workflow_item_key mailer_component action status severity message sechub_fixture_marker | sort - _time

| search event_family="ebs_fnd_security_error" OR event_type="fnd_log" | table _time user application module component error_code request_uri action status severity message sechub_fixture_marker | sort - _time

| search event_family IN ("ebs_ohs_suspicious_http","ebs_weblogic_security","ebs_forms_oaf_error") | table _time event_family src_ip user server_name http_method request_uri http_status form function status severity message sechub_fixture_marker | sort - _time

table.title: May 2026 Oracle Payments and June 2026 ECC / module focus

search.query: | search isnotnull(cve) OR application IN ("Oracle Payments","Oracle Enterprise Command Center Framework","Oracle Payroll","Oracle iSupplier Portal") | table _time cve advisory_month application module component action status severity user src_ip request_uri message sechub_fixture_marker | sort - _time

table.title: Top users, responsibilities, and source IPs

search.query: | stats count values(responsibility) as responsibilities values(src_ip) as src_ips values(status) as statuses by user | sort - count | head 20
| stats count values(event_family) as families values(cve) as cves values(severity) as severities by component | sort - count
| table _time sourcetype source host event_family user application action status severity sechub_fixture_marker _raw | sort - _time | head 50

html.pre: index=main sourcetype="oracle:ebs:security:json" source_mode="ebs_security_json_relay" | spath | table _time index sourcetype source host event_family user ebs_user responsibility application module action status severity cve request_uri message sechub_fixture_marker _raw | sort - _time
